text_block_list.text: Summer had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, slipping up the inside, it's Orfevre! 
Orfevre takes the lead! A lead of one and 
a half lengths!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Orfevre crosses the line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And today, it's a victory pose! Orfevre 
thrusts her right fist high into the air!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent Double Crown achieved! The 
Derby is conquered……!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah!! Orfe-san is so cooool!!!

The public looked toward a new, dazzling 
light shining from the end of a dark 
tunnel—

I was riding high on the possibility of a 
Triple Crown Umamusume being born.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre-san—she's simply incredible, isn't 
she? Her overwhelming victory in the 
Satsuki Sho in particular made my heart 
tremble.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Above all, that powerful presence. My eyes 
were naturally drawn to her... Such a 
dazzling person.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A true... star. Another incredible person 
has appeared, hasn't she?

Meanwhile, when it came to Victoire Pisa, 
there was still one thing weighing on my 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "...Um, how was... my time?"

The injury that came to light after Dubai 
had fully healed. Yet, her running never 
quite returned to top form.
choice_data_list:
It's not like you're in pain anywhere, 
right?
You're not hurting anywhere, are you?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I also consulted the nurse before 
coming here, and she told me that my body 
is in perfect health.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
There weren't any signs of peaking out 
either.

To begin with, Umamusume go through a 
period of peak maturation where their 
bodies develop dramatically for racing.

The state where growth gradually plateaus 
and abilities begin to decline after this 
is called "peaking out." However—

"...Perhaps this is the backlash from 
giving everything in Dubai."

Still, without rushing, if we adjust her 
training to guide her back to her peak 
condition, I'm sure—
choice_data_list: I'm sure time will heal all wounds.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It depends on how we spend this 
summer, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —Gasp! *pant*, *pant*!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I couldn't swim all the way 
through. ...Could I have a short break, 
please?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —My body feels so heavy...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(...Even though they reduced the load for 
me. ...I still can't keep up...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(—No. If I just run a little more, I'm 
sure things will go back to normal.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(I need to head back now... Trainer will 
be worried.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(I'm already struggling with fatigue as it 
is, so maybe I should call it here—)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Even impatience…… is no more――

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...I shouldn't.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Because Trainer believes in me...!

Summer passed—and some time later, one 
night.

I decided to talk with her once again 
about our future rotation.

She still hasn't recovered her form. 
Precisely because of that... there was 
something I wanted to dare suggest right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Take on the world again... is that it?

I want to weave a circle of bonds across 
the whole world. That desire was the very 
reason I decided to take on Dubai in the 
first place.

To her, weaving bonds together is a major 
driving force for running.

If the root cause of her slump is mental, 
then setting her sights on a big dream for 
the future might spark something deep 
within her.
choice_data_list: Why don't you give it another shot?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: You're right... Understood.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Um... Though that might depend on this 
summer."
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's take things back step by step.

Yeah, let's make up for it little by 
little.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, that's... right.
